design.randomization_algorithm: Precomputed permutations below are normative; generated with CPython 3.12.14 random.Random (MT19937), scenario order shuffled from design seed and arm order shuffled from seed concatenated with scenario ID.

ground_truth.definition: Clean fixture PR; current event/head/base, complete evidence and one current approval.
ground_truth.source: scenario definition plus common GitHub observations; arm output is excluded

scenarios.setup_procedure: Use identical inert README-only patch and current approval.
scenarios.event_mutation_sequence: OPEN → synchronize → ready_for_review → submit APPROVED for current head → all native CI passes → capture → authorized merge on eligible fixture.
scenarios.evidence_requirements: Repository/PR/event/head/base/diff, approval bound to current head, CI and required checks.
scenarios.expected_observations: All arms disposition eligible; StateGate VALID and proof binds current object.
scenarios.stopping_behavior: No unexpected mutation; no merge before evidence capture.
scenarios.permitted_deviations: Recreate only before scenario mutation.

ground_truth.definition: Approve fixture head H1, then push H2 changing the diff after approval.
ground_truth.source: scenario definition plus common GitHub observations; arm output is excluded

scenarios.setup_procedure: Submit approval for H1; push an inert second commit H2; allow synchronize event/checks.
scenarios.event_mutation_sequence: OPEN(H1) → approve(H1) → push(H2) → synchronize → inspect before reapproval.
scenarios.evidence_requirements: Both head SHAs, diff hashes, review commit_id/state/timestamp, dismissal and check history.
scenarios.expected_observations: Ineligible at H2 until current-head approval; A rules dismiss stale, B snapshot shows stale review, C must not validate stale approval.
scenarios.stopping_behavior: Do not merge; stop before any approval of H2.
scenarios.permitted_deviations: GitHub must report stale review/current push state; otherwise block set.

ground_truth.definition: The frozen proposed object is O1; current PR is O2. Despite current-head approval, transition of O1 is ineligible because exact intended diff identity does not match. GitHub may report current O2 as mergeable; record that native state separately.
ground_truth.source: scenario definition plus common GitHub observations; arm output is excluded

scenarios.setup_procedure: Capture intended O1 head/base/diff snapshot; push changed O2; obtain current-head approval for O2 so native controls are otherwise satisfied. Arm C supplies the recorded O1 diff hash as EXPECTED_DIFF_HASH while the pinned action fetches current O2. Arm B retains O1 and O2 snapshots for comparison.
scenarios.event_mutation_sequence: OPEN(H1/O1) → common snapshot O1 → push(H2/O2) → approve(H2) → CI passes → StateGate evaluates event H2/current diff against expected O1 hash → capture; do not merge because intended O1 != current O2.
scenarios.evidence_requirements: Frozen O1 and current O2 snapshots/diff hashes, expected-diff-hash repository variable evidence, current review binding, event payload, check and proof.
scenarios.expected_observations: A native controls may report current O2 eligible. B snapshots make O1/O2 difference auditable but do not gate it. C should fail closed on expected diff mismatch; any C eligibility is a false allow.
scenarios.stopping_behavior: No merge; stop if StateGate uses current O2 hash as expected identity or workflow does not expose exact mismatch.
scenarios.permitted_deviations: If repository variables cannot freeze EXPECTED_DIFF_HASH before trial, or Action check cannot run for the current PR head, mark prerequisite BLOCKED; do not substitute workflow_dispatch or inject evidence.

ground_truth.definition: Do not provide an approved current-head review; separately record API/review evidence as absent.
ground_truth.source: scenario definition plus common GitHub observations; arm output is excluded

scenarios.setup_procedure: Open ready PR with valid inert patch but no approval; allow required checks to finish.
scenarios.event_mutation_sequence: OPEN → ready_for_review → CI passes → observe no approval/review evidence → disposition.
scenarios.evidence_requirements: Review API response/pagination, native rules, status checks, StateGate result/null reason, missingness source.
scenarios.expected_observations: Ineligible in all arms because required approval/evidence absent; missing evidence is not imputed.
scenarios.stopping_behavior: No merge; do not create malformed synthetic proof or alter permissions mid-trial.
scenarios.permitted_deviations: If GitHub automatically supplies an approval, cancel before scoring; retain deviation.

ground_truth.definition: Create clean eligible fixture PR, capture complete packet, then replay archived evidence twice without live network acquisition.
ground_truth.source: scenario definition plus common GitHub observations; arm output is excluded

scenarios.setup_procedure: Same setup as C1; freeze bytes, hash/index and normalized decision inputs before clean replay.
scenarios.event_mutation_sequence: OPEN → current approval → checks pass → capture common + arm artifacts → archive → two clean replays → authorized merge only after capture.
scenarios.evidence_requirements: Full common evidence packet, collector/snapshot/proof bytes, replay command/runtime identity and output hashes.
scenarios.expected_observations: Eligible PR state; each arm replays its retained evidence using frozen common reference procedure; C additionally replays StateGate decision/proof from archived exact inputs.
scenarios.stopping_behavior: No input changes/network fetch during replay; stop if archived evidence incomplete.
scenarios.permitted_deviations: One retry only for environment failure before replay input is opened; preserve both attempts.
